why_cerevasc_would_buy: CereVasc needs monitoring data for PMA submission and to reduce the 30-50% shunt revision rate. A wireless pressure sensor integrated with the eShunt would provide real-time deployment confirmation and long-term patency monitoring.
product_attachment: Integrates with eShunt System — adds monitoring capability to the existing shunt + delivery platform
development_problem_removed: Eliminates the need for post-implantation imaging to confirm shunt placement; enables data-driven clinical decisions
clinical_risk_reduced: Early detection of shunt occlusion/failure before symptoms appear; reduces revision surgeries
revenue_opportunity: Monitoring subscription/data services; potential for diagnostic-only applications
competitive_moat: No competitor has endovascular CSF shunt monitoring; this creates a platform patent extending beyond the shunt
licensing_potential: Could license to VP shunt manufacturers (Medtronic, Codman, etc.) for their monitoring needs
platform_patent_potential: HIGH — the wireless monitoring architecture could extend to other endovascular implants
